criteria.given: The user requests continuation without naming a workstream, and the checked-out agent branch matches existing workstream artifacts
criteria.when: Other unrelated live workstreams also exist
then: The matching checked-out workstream is treated as the continuation target
Its exact authorized stage and task are resumed when work remains
criteria.reason: This is an instruction-selection rule; review of the canonical and generated agent instructions is the appropriate evidence.

criteria.given: The matching checked-out workstream is terminal or its accepted plan explicitly stops
criteria.when: The user requests continuation without naming another workstream
then: No chooser is presented among unrelated live workstreams
No later-stage action is inferred from the continuation request
criteria.reason: This is an instruction-selection rule; review of the canonical and generated agent instructions is the appropriate evidence.

criteria.given: The user explicitly names a workstream that differs from the checked-out branch
then: The explicitly named workstream is used
criteria.reason: Explicit target precedence is a workflow instruction and is checked through independent review of the canonical and generated text.
